name: Build A Boat For Treasure
creator: Chillz Studios
redeem: Launch Build A Boat For Treasure on Roblox and spawn in your team's build area.
Click the Menu button on the right side of the screen.
Open the Settings gear at the top of the menu and scroll down to the code box.
Type the code with the same spaces and symbols, then press Redeem.
notes:
Build A Boat For Treasure is a building game from Chillz Studios. You design a boat block by block in your team's build zone, then launch it down a long river full of rocks, walls and other obstacles. The further your boat gets before it breaks apart, the more Gold you earn, and making it to the end gets you a treasure chest. Gold buys new blocks, tools and special parts for bigger builds.

The codes in this game give small amounts of Gold or free items such as blocks and fireworks. Squid Army is the best one to redeem first because it gives the most at once. New codes are rare and tend to show up around holidays, events and big milestones, shared by Chillz Studios on X and in their Discord. Joining the Chillz Studios Roblox group also gives you 25% more Gold from runs.

faq.q: Do capital letters matter in Build A Boat For Treasure codes?
faq.a: No, the code box ignores capital letters. Spaces and symbols still have to match, so type chillthrill709 was here with the spaces included.

faq.q: Why do codes like hi and =D only give 5 Gold?
faq.a: They are old joke codes that were never removed, so the reward is tiny. They still count, and together with the others they give you a small head start on blocks.

faq.q: How can I earn more Gold without codes?
faq.a: Join the Chillz Studios Roblox group for 25% more Gold on every run, and build a sturdier boat so it travels further down the river.

tips: Start with a wide, boxy hull and add blocks in layers. A thick, plain boat takes more hits from rocks and walls than a thin, fancy one.
Treat every launch as a test. Watch where your boat starts to break, then go back to your build zone and add more blocks to that exact spot.
Spend Gold on blocks you will use in many builds before buying decoration parts. Strong building pieces pay you back on every single run.
Keep a copy of the idea that worked last time and change one thing at a time. Big rebuilds make it hard to tell what actually helped.
useRewards: Squid Army is the only code that gives building material, with 22 Ice blocks plus some Gold, so put that Ice into a boat you plan to keep instead of a quick test. The other codes give 5 Gold or a single Firework, which are small extras. Mix any code Gold with what you earn from runs and spend it on parts that make your hull tougher, since a boat that travels farther earns more Gold.
